reviews.text: Decent selection for a small store. Staff were nice.

I went to the pet outlet to buy a very expensive item, but I couldn't find it. So I approached a colleague who was with another colleague at the checkout. During the conversation, I said good afternoon, and they continued talking. Then I said excuse me, and they continued talking. However, I said "excuse me," and they were quiet and listened to me. I only said three words, and the woman replied rudely that they didn't have it without even checking if it was in stock. If they wanted to talk, they should go to a café and at least attend to customers instead of pretending to be deaf. They lost a long-time customer and a high-value purchase. I will never frequent another pet outlet I visit. Thank you! They were always very helpful, but from today on I will go to the competitors who actually like to talk to their customers!

It's not a good store for those looking for products for fish and reptiles.

The staff are friendly, but unfortunately it's a store geared towards dogs and cats.

The two employees I've been assisted by have all the necessary qualifications for working in a pet shop. In addition to being attentive and knowledgeable about their roles, they love animals.
I regret that the shop can't offer even more competitive prices because it would have even more customers.
They don't adhere to the opening hours.
Poor service. They prioritize small talk over assisting those who actually need to buy something.
Friendliness and professionalism. They handle complaints and orders the same way. That's how you build customer loyalty!
Excellent staff, extremely friendly, I highly recommend them ❤️
